title: License Compliance in Open Source Cybersecurity Projects
abstract: arXiv:2609.21218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developers of cybersecurity software often include and rely upon open source software packages in their commercial software products. Before open source code is absorbed into a proprietary product, developers must check the package license to see if the project is permissively licensed, thereby allowing for commercial-friendly inheritance and redistribution. However, there is a risk that the open source package license could be inaccurate due to being silently contaminated with restrictively licensed open source code that may prohibit the sale or confidentiality of commercial derivative work. Contamination of commercial products could lead to expensive remediation costs, damage to the company's reputation, and costly legal fees. translated_title: 开源网络安全项目中的许可证合规性
translated_abstract: 网络安全软件的开发者经常在其商业软件产品中包含并依赖开源软件包。在开源代码被吸收到专有产品中之前，开发者必须检查软件包的许可证，以确认该项目是否采用宽松式许可证，从而允许商业友好的继承和再分发。然而，开源软件包的许可证存在不准确的风险，因为其可能被悄然污染了限制性许可的开源代码，这些代码可能禁止商业衍生作品的销售或保密。商业产品受到污染可能导致昂贵的修复成本、公司声誉受损以及高额的法律费用。在本文中，我们报告了对200多个开源网络安全项目的初步分析，以识别最常用的许可证类型和编程语言，并寻找宽松式许可项目中存在污染的证据。
tldr: 该研究对200多个开源网络安全项目进行了初步分析，识别最常用的许可证类型和编程语言，并检查宽松式许可证项目是否存在被限制性许可代码污染的风险。
en_tdlr: This study presents a preliminary analysis of over 200 open source cybersecurity projects to identify the most frequently used license types and languages, and to look for evidence of license contamination in permissively licensed projects.
